data.translation: And we thank those brothers who undertake every work, labour which gives benefit to our Syriac people and those who call themselves Assyrians and Chaldeans; it makes no difference.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (Jan 3.17/249)

data.turoyo: Xori ʕAziz: E... Tašʕiṯ ḥayaw d xor efisqufo ʕAziz Gunal d ḥa ḥad d bay d kuhne d Ṣṭanbəl. Ihido xori-efisqufo ʕAziz Gunal b gunše iṯaw, men Kfarze. Qriṯo dəb ḥḏon d Məḏyaḏ. Qəṣṭro d Mardin. W en sisarto, səryayto, səryayto ortodokso mšamahto d Beṯ-Xəwaǧa. Əšme d abo Skandar.
data.translation: Xori Aziz: Yes... The life history of Chorepiscopus Aziz Gunal, one of the clergy of Istanbul. The said Chorepiscopus Aziz Gunal is by origin from Kfarze, a village in the vicinity of Midyat, in the district of Mardin, and from a Syriac, Syriac Orthodox family called Beth Khwaja. His father's name was Skandar.

rationale: Second Detransitive Part. Pass. naming example after R1; family subject and overt name distinguish naming from fame. Learned biographical register retained. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.
